ideas.title: Jensen Huang resigns as NVIDIA CEO with immediate effect; CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO
ideas.hook: 33 years NVIDIA ని నడిపిన Jensen Huang ఒక్కసారిగా ఎందుకు దిగిపోయారు? AI boom కి దీని అర్థం ఏంటి?
points: Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately. NVIDIA's release cites his 33 years of leadership.
CFO Colette Kress, who joined NVIDIA in September 2013, is interim CEO and keeps her finance role. The board is searching for a permanent CEO, internal or external.
Harvey C. Jones, the former Synopsys CEO, is named NVIDIA's first-ever Board Chair.
Q3 fiscal 2027 results are due on 2026-11-17. CNBC reports that NVIDIA's $500B+ financing pact with Apollo, BlackRock and others has produced no deals so far.

ideas.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a cheap, fast 'daily driver' model for agentic coding and everyday tasks
ideas.hook: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: తక్కువ price, 2.5x speed, coding test లో 18% నుంచి 57% కి jump. ఇంత cheap AI ఇంత powerful ఎలా?
points: Price is $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, flat across the full 1M-token context window.
Google says it scores 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1, against 18.2% for Gemini 3.8 Flash. It also finishes tasks about 2.5x faster at the default 'high' thinking setting.
Google claims 5x fewer fabricated claims than 3.8 Flash. It ranks only #5 on Agent Arena (MarkTechPost). The benchmark figures are Google's own.
It is rolling out in the Gemini API, AI Studio, the Gemini app and Search.

ideas.title: ElevenLabs launches Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live speech-to-text across 102 languages, with Hindi gains and an India data region
ideas.hook: మనం మాట్లాడేది AI ఎంత correct గా రాయగలదు? 102 languages, Hindi లో 36% better: ElevenLabs Scribe v3 కథ
points: Scribe v3 makes 27% fewer word errors than Scribe v2 across 102 languages. Another report puts overall WER at 12.4%, against 17.0% for v2 and 18.5% for Gemini 3.5 Transcribe.
Scribe v3 Live is the first realtime model from ElevenLabs with speaker labelling. Hindi improves 36% over Scribe v2 Realtime.
In ElevenLabs' earlier figures, Tamil errors fell 29% on the batch model.
Isolated India, EU and Singapore environments are available for enterprise customers. The benchmarks are all ElevenLabs' own.

ideas.title: SpaceX Starship Flight 15 launches with a planned double catch, but the booster catch is cancelled for safety
ideas.hook: Starship Flight 15: Rocket ని tower తో పట్టుకోవాలనుకున్నారు, last minute లో ఎందుకు వదిలేశారు?
points: Launched 4:47 p.m. CT (2247 GMT) on Nov 13 from Starbase, Texas
Super Heavy booster tower catch cancelled for safety; booster did an offshore splashdown (it had been caught 3 times before)
Ship 42 deployed 26 Starlink satellites, 3 with cameras to inspect the ship's heat shield
Plan: ship stays in orbit up to 22 hours, then a first-ever tower catch of the ship (result not confirmed by the finder); Starship is 124 m tall, ~17 million lbf thrust

ideas.title: NASA unveils up to $10 billion in Moon Base delivery contracts, including a Blue Origin delivery of the PROMISE rover
ideas.hook: చంద్రుడి మీద permanent base: NASA $10 billion plan లో అసలు ఏముంది?
points: CLPS-2: 10-year contract vehicle with a $10 billion ceiling (a maximum, not money awarded); 8 companies eligible incl. SpaceX, Blue Origin, Firefly, Intuitive Machines
6 VADR task orders to Arrow Science and Technology, Blue Origin and Impulse Space, about $1.3 billion combined
Blue Origin's Mark 1 lander will deliver JPL's PROMISE rover to the lunar south pole: $94 million base + $140 million option
NASA expects the moon base to cost about $30 billion and aims to build it by 2032; announced Nov 7 at Kennedy Space Center

ideas.title: Euclid space telescope releases its first big data set: 1,900 square degrees of sky and over 1 billion objects
ideas.hook: Euclid telescope కొత్త map: 100 కోట్ల objects తో dark universe secret బయటపడుతుందా?
points: DR1-Foundation release: about 13 months of observations, ~1,900 square degrees of sky (roughly 9,500 full Moons)
Light from more than 1 billion objects, about 14% of the sky Euclid will cover in its 6-year mission
600-megapixel camera; data include a new comet and the most ancient quasar known
Full DR1 with galaxy clustering and weak lensing products expected mid-2027

ideas.title: A robot builds a structure autonomously in space for the first time (DARPA NOM4D)
ideas.hook: Space లో మనిషి లేకుండా robot ఒక్కటే building కట్టింది: ఇది ఎందుకు పెద్ద విషయం?
points: A gantry robot assembled a truss from individual Caltech-supplied parts, applying a thin reflective mesh like a space antenna
SpaceX launched the Caltech NOM4D payload in March 2026; idea to working prototype in orbit in 15 months
Goal: structures hundreds of meters to kilometers in size: big antennas, solar arrays, orbital stations, lunar habitats
Next: University of Illinois ISS test of composite material processing with a monomer resin

ideas.title: A Pakistani astronaut will become the first foreign visitor to China's Tiangong space station
ideas.hook: China space station లోకి మొదటి foreign astronaut: Pakistan కి ఈ chance ఎలా వచ్చింది?
points: A Pakistani payload specialist (not yet named) will fly up on Shenzhou-24 and return on Shenzhou-23
Stay of several days to about a week; mission expected by end of 2026 (a Nov 25 date from a Pakistani official is not confirmed by China)
Comes from a February 2025 agreement; two Pakistani candidates selected in April 2026
First time China has helped a foreign nation select and train astronauts
